claims.text: The Royal Palace account describes Bangkok’s 1782 capital relocation. Chiang Mai’s institutional account names Kawila as local ruler under a tributary relationship with RamaI. A central capital and a named local ruling institution are different relations. Working paraphrase and retrospective accounts do not establish timeless direct rule or universal assent.
